g.text: CampusClaw Session Live Stream - Candidate Lifecycle
check Session exists and is not deleted
Wait for connected before submitting a separate POST.
This GET never updates credentials of an active execution.
complete event after commit, in internal order
data: JSON with eventId and type
transport closes; no business success implied
Idle is not end of subscription
: ping while waiting for new events
reopen GET stream and wait for connected
reconcile by eventId; keep history order
Preview may be shed; completed events replace preview.
Network writes never hold the Session DB transaction.
Disconnect does not cancel execution or replay a POST.
No SSE id, Last-Event-ID replay, or public sequence is proposed.
